cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(lua C)

# 1. Get all C files from the src folder
file(GLOB LUA_SOURCES "src/*.c")

# 2. Exclude the command-line tools (we only want the library)
#    (These files contain "main" functions which would confuse your app)
list(REMOVE_ITEM LUA_SOURCES 
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lua.c" 
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/luac.c"
)

# 3. Create the library target named "lua"
add_library(lua STATIC ${LUA_SOURCES})

# 4. Automatically share the include path with anyone who links this
target_include_directories(lua PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
